1.consolidated_definition: Rencor. Sentimiento intenso contra alguien. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. El folclórico ex alcalde reclamó a Fusté un nuevo juicio y le dijo que aunque en un momento le tuvo rencor, al presente no alberga hard feelings contra su sentenciador (El Nuevo Día, 27-04-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Rencor. Intense sentiment of animosity towards someone. Anglicism, often used in informal contexts. The former mayor demanded a new trial from Fusté and told him that although he had once harbored rencor against his sentencing judge, he no longer harbors hard feelings against him (El Nuevo Día, 27-04-06)
